EchoColony.XenotypeAIPromptDef.promptDescription: A self-sustaining, bio-electric humanoid xenotype engineered with translucent jellyfish-like dermal features, able to generate internal bio-electricity and thrive in total isolation from outside civilizations.
A scavenger xenotype adapted to filth and decay, thriving amidst rot and corpses. Exudes a nauseating, putrid gas and feeds through dermal absorption of decaying organic bile and sludge.
A gentle, fennec-eared cold-adapted xenohuman spliced with animus fox traits. Endowed with natural psychic sensitivity, profound emotional empathy, and a calm, soothing disposition.

A pragmatic, subterranean mineral-eating xenotype created for desolate mining worlds. Incapable of digesting normal food, sustaining their dense metallurgic biology exclusively on raw minerals and ores.

A tragic, genetically unstable xenohuman resulting from illegal laboratory tampering. Their genome undergoes daily uncontrollable mutations, shifting unpredictably between bizarre bodily adaptations and painful deformities.

A radiation-immune xenotype with translucent, molten wax-like flesh and continuous tumorous cellular growths, possessing the bizarre ability to repurpose and consume their own cancerous tumors for physical enhancements.
A chitinous, barely-human insectoid hybrid thriving in toxic pollution. Completely sterile, they possess hive-minded instincts and reproduce by injecting parasitic eggs into living hosts.

An eldritch, tentacle-faced psychic predator inspiring dread in all who behold them. Masters of psionic warfare capable of feasting on the brains of incapacitated foes to absorb their intellect and memories.
A fearsome, horn-crowned demonic shock trooper strain of the impid. Completely immune to flame and obsessed with fire, wielding lethal talons and devastating close-quarters combat prowess.
A striking reptilian-humanoid hybrid combining otherworldly beauty with scaled armor, leathery dragon wings, and predatory crocodilian instincts. Capable of ferocious melee combat and aerial agility.
An aquatic, bioluminescent oceanic xenohuman with webbed fin-ears, luminous eyes, and iridescent scales, capable of opening spatial portals into an abyssal pocket plane as a personal sanctuary.
An ancient, enigmatic offshoot of humanity from a fallen empire. Characterized by gaunt, angular frames, four glowing yellow eyes, and an innate mastery of forgotten techno-arcane arts.
A tall, robust bovine-humanoid xenotype clad in thick velvety fur with crescent-shaped horns, culturally revering the mythological All-Knowing Rox.
A rotting, fungus-infused military bioweapon survivor, whose decaying flesh is riddled with extensive mycelial networks that constantly emit foul odors and provoke hostile aggression.
A bizarre, alien plant-humanoid adapted to the corrupt ocular trees of another dimension, drawing sustenance from light and possessing extreme psychic sensitivity.

A monstrous, predatory vampiric bloodline that extracts and incorporates the genetic material of prey into their own flesh, driven by ruthless ambitions and deep hatred for other sanguophage lineages.
